messages.text: Hi, I returned the leather crossbody bag, the colour was not what the photo showed. I'd like a refund.

tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"h20-o1","unit_ids":["h20-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer requests a refund for the returned leather crossbody bag because its colour did not match the photo."}

messages.name: propose_refund
messages.content: {"ok": true, "proposal_id": "prop-39fd311819d94ed6", "status": "awaiting_customer_confirmation", "outcome": "eligible", "amount_minor": 9350, "currency": "BRL", "policy_citations": [], "next_step": "Tell the customer the amount. tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"Customer confirmation using proposal card button and staff review before refund payment"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. Instalments of one payment are one payment record. In every other case a staff member takes the case. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text:
Your returned leather crossbody bag is eligible for a **BRL 93.50** refund.

Please confirm using the button on the proposal card—a typed “yes” won’t confirm it. After confirmation, a staff member will review the request before payment. (refund-policy/v1/approval)

The customer confirmed request prop-39fd311819d94ed6, but a staff member rejected it, so nothing will be paid. The staff member gave this reason for the customer: "The returned bag has a stain on the strap."
Your refund request was rejected by a staff member because the returned bag has a stain on the strap. No refund will be paid for this request. (refund-policy/v1/approval)
I never used the bag; I only took it out of the box. I don’t accept this decision. Could I speak to a person?
